LanguageData.FieldworkCompanions.Settings.Title: Fieldwork Companions
LanguageData.FieldworkCompanions.Settings.Intro: An animal set to follow its master while doing field work now earns its keep: when it is at hand, the work turns up a little more than it should.\n\nThe animal must have learned obedience — the game already requires that before an animal respects a master at all.
LanguageData.FieldworkCompanions.Settings.MiningTip: Rock and ore mined by hand. Deep drills do not receive this bonus.
LanguageData.FieldworkCompanions.Settings.HarvestTip: Crops and wild plants alike. Cutting a plant down is not harvesting and yields no bonus.
LanguageData.FieldworkCompanions.Settings.FishingTip: Requires Odyssey. One extra fish, drawn from the catch that was just landed. An animal fishing on its own is never assisted.
LanguageData.FieldworkCompanions.Settings.GatheringTi: The animal being milked or sheared never counts as its own helper.
LanguageData.FieldworkCompanions.Settings.RequireSpec: Mining asks for the "dig" training, harvesting for "forage" — both added by Odyssey. Fishing, milking and shearing have no training of their own, so obedience is enough for them. Turn this off and obedience is enough everywhere.
LanguageData.FieldworkCompanions.Settings.BaseChanceT: For an obedient companion with no further training.
LanguageData.FieldworkCompanions.Settings.PerStepTip: The "dig" and "forage" trainings have three steps each. Fishing, milking and shearing have none, so this adds nothing there.
LanguageData.FieldworkCompanions.Settings.BondTip: The animal is bonded to the colonist it is helping.
LanguageData.FieldworkCompanions.Settings.ShareTip: A share of what the action normally produces, rounded, and never less than one. Fishing ignores this: it always adds exactly one fish.
LanguageData.FieldworkCompanions.Settings.RadiusTip: How close the companion must be to count as present.
LanguageData.FieldworkCompanions.Settings.BondChanceT: Working side by side draws the two together. Set to zero to leave bonding to the vanilla routes.
LanguageData.FieldworkCompanions.Settings.ShowMote: Show a mark over the companion
LanguageData.FieldworkCompanions.Settings.ShowMoteTip: So you can see which animal found the extra.
LanguageData.FieldworkCompanions.Settings.ConfirmRese: Reset every Fieldwork Companions setting to its default?
